chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Hamdan al-Qalanisi, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hudhayni, from Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Marwan, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, who said:

I wrote to Abul Hasan the Third (peace be upon him) asking him about the Ziyarah of the grave of Abi Abdillah and about the Ziyarah of the graves of Abul Hasan and Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him). Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) replied, 'Abi Abdillah comes first, but that is more complete and has a greater reward.'

key_terms.الْمُقَدَّمُ: The one who comes first / Precedence

ai.seo_question: What is the difference in reward between visiting the grave of Imam Husayn versus Imam Kadhim and Imam Jawad?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibrahim ibn Uqbah inquires about the comparative merit of visiting the shrines of Imam al-Husayn (AS), Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS), and Imam Muhammad al-Jawad al-Jawad (AS). Imam al-Hadi (AS) responds that while the preeminence of Imam al-Husayn is acknowledged, the Ziyarah of the latter two Imams is described as 'more comprehensive and greater in reward,' highlighting the unique spiritual status of the Imams buried in Baghdad. This distinction underscores the Shia scholarly view that while Karbala holds a singular place in collective memory, the shrines of the Imams in their respective cities also serve as profound centers of devotion and divine grace.
